en.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
en.fact: It hangs in the Louvre behind bulletproof glass. It was stolen in 1911 and only recovered in 1913.

es.question: ¿Quién pintó la Mona Lisa?
es.fact: Está en el Louvre detrás de un vidrio blindado. La robaron en 1911 y recién la recuperaron en 1913.

en.question: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
en.fact: The play is set in Verona, where a house said to be Juliet's draws crowds of tourists to its balcony.

en.question: Who painted The Starry Night?
en.fact: He painted it in 1889 while staying at a hospital in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, based on the view from his window.

en.question: Which author created Sherlock Holmes?
en.fact: Holmes never actually says "Elementary, my dear Watson" in any of Conan Doyle's stories.

en.question: Who wrote One Hundred Years of Solitude?
en.fact: It's set in the made-up town of Macondo. He won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1982.

en.question: Which Spanish artist co-founded Cubism?
en.fact: He developed Cubism together with the French painter Georges Braque.

en.question: Which novel begins with the line "Call me Ishmael"?
options: The Old Man and the Sea
en.fact: Herman Melville's novel sold poorly in his lifetime and only became a classic after he died.
